nodes.label: Image Version Smoke Check
nodes.rationale: The baked APP_VERSION must match the release tag before any image is pushed.

nodes.label: Coordinate System Discipline
nodes.rationale: SVG and layout use downward-positive Y while manifold3d uses upward-positive Y, so Y must be negated at the boundary.

nodes.label: Image Downscaling Contract
nodes.rationale: Uploads are capped at 2048 pixels and scale_factor must follow the downscale ratio to preserve physical measurements.

nodes.label: Coordinate System Discipline
nodes.rationale: Geometry crossing from SVG or layout coordinates into manifold3d must negate Y.

nodes.label: Offline First
nodes.rationale: The application must remain fully functional without network access or API keys, with network features serving only as optional enhancements.

nodes.label: Pluggable Inference
nodes.rationale: Tool identification and categorisation must not depend on one model or remote service and require manual or simple fallbacks.

nodes.label: Photo Tracing Scope Boundary
nodes.rationale: Tracefinity is specifically a photo-to-gridfinity workflow, not a general outline-to-bin or 2D-to-3D converter.

nodes.label: Backward Compatible Schemas
nodes.rationale: New fields need defaults so existing user data loads without migration.

nodes.label: Atomic Data Operations
nodes.rationale: Replacing user data must use an atomic swap so partial failure cannot lose data.

nodes.label: Single Configuration Source
nodes.rationale: Configuration should be owned by pydantic-settings instead of mixing direct environment access with Settings.

nodes.label: Event Driven UI Updates
nodes.rationale: Background task updates should use server-sent events or websockets when they fit instead of polling loops.

nodes.label: Persistence Warning
nodes.rationale: Without a persistent volume, tool-library and project data are lost when the pod restarts.

nodes.label: Local Storage Single Replica Constraint
nodes.rationale: The chart defaults to one replica because application persistence uses local storage.

nodes.label: Placed Tool Library Synchronization
nodes.rationale: Placed tools retain their position while geometry, holes, and names are refreshed from the library source.

nodes.label: Y-Axis Inversion Contract
nodes.rationale: SVG and bin coordinates are Y-down while generated geometry is Y-up, so Y must be negated exactly once at the boundary.

nodes.label: Cutout Pipeline Ordering
nodes.rationale: Smoothing must precede clearance so simplification tolerance cannot erode the requested printed clearance.

nodes.label: EXIF Orientation Normalization
nodes.rationale: Orientation is baked into pixels at ingest so browser coordinates and backend image coordinates remain in the same frame.

nodes.label: Three.js Resource Disposal
nodes.rationale: Regenerated geometries and image effects require cleanup to prevent browser memory exhaustion.

nodes.label: Non-Fatal Naming Fallback
nodes.rationale: Unavailable providers, invalid responses, and exhausted retries preserve the existing generic label rather than failing tracing.

nodes.label: Stopped-Container Consistent Backup
nodes.rationale: Stopping the service avoids copying JSON files while writes are in flight.

nodes.label: Smooth Versus Accurate Outlines
nodes.rationale: Accurate mode preserves editable raw vertices, while smooth mode trades direct vertex editing for a simplified Chaikin outline that does not overshoot.

nodes.label: Paper Size Determines Scale
nodes.rationale: The selected physical paper size determines real-world scaling for outlines, bins, and exported geometry.

nodes.label: Global Display Help and Settings Controls
